units.halos: G=1; physical radius and peculiar velocity in code units; alpha=2/3,t0=12 for expanding cases.

figure_input_scopes.1: Four labeled records demonstrate insertion sorting and stable decimal radix sorting. The actual radius routine uses eight stable base-256 byte passes.
figure_input_scopes.2: Four resolved power-law curves, two Gaussian full-particle datasets at11 actual native times, five stable power-law own-bound samples joined at their actual times, and one Gaussian E_full<0 own-gravity endpoint. Gaussian connecting lines guide the eye.
figure_input_scopes.3: All three rows use CUDA BP calculations at their actual saved times.
figure_input_scopes.4: All three CUDA BP calculations reach time10000, using native times0,100,800,10000. Native positive density and finite centered21-cell slopes are retained; Neff>=32 marks emphasized sections.
figure_input_scopes.5: CUDA VP and BP calculations with identical initial marker masses and orbital phase coordinates; both reach time 10000. The same BP profiles also supply Figure3.
figure_input_scopes.6,7: All marker mass enters each reduction of the CUDA gamma_i=0.5 BP calculation. Energy is instantaneous subhalo-center orbital energy.
figure_input_scopes.7: Mean orbital phase-space distribution M_bin/Delta_Omega and nine-bin quadratic logarithmic energy derivative. Energy is instantaneous; dashed bins/windows meet the stated inner-field criterion.
figure_input_scopes.8: Complete static and expanding collisionless trajectories from time 0 to 3000, with static endpoint energy selections and a larger-wall control from 2406.32 to 3000.
figure_input_scopes.9: Four Gaussian cases,512 native radial cells,positive densities and21-cell logarithmic slopes. Eight actual times per case include the initial collapse and latest displayed state. Thick portions have center-cell effective count at least32.
figure_input_scopes.10: The original nine SIDM profiles retain exact density, centered radial variance and population values. New slope subpanels use the existing21-cell centered quadratic fit with positive-density windows, center population8/32 for thin/heavy segments, and the published long-mean-free-path SIDM envelope reference -2.19 (Balberg,Shapiro,Inagaki2002).

halo_profile_display: Thin curves show positive native densities and finite 21-cell quadratic slopes; thick sections require effective marker population Neff>=32 at their centers.

virial_summary.physical_scope: Expanding power-law curves use approved resolved-profile moments. Gaussian curves use emitted complete-particle applied-force moments. Static gamma=.5 symbols use iterative self-bound subsets in their own reconstructed field at five stable snapshots. Cold controls remain a distinct figure.

input.meaning: Fixed identifiers and decimal teaching keys for insertion and stable radix sorting.

sorting_algorithms.label: ID identifies a fixed record. K is its teaching key.
sorting_algorithms.current_radius_order: After the latest drift, a permutation orders the current radii. Each identifier retains its particle properties.
sorting_algorithms.force_scope: SphDSMC uses the ordered mass prefix and half of the shell own mass for shell gravity. WPIC orders collision partners and computes gravity from deposited mesh mass.
sorting_algorithms.decimal_scope: Units and tens passes illustrate stable digit distribution. The implementation uses eight bytes on finite nonnegative binary64 radius keys.

gaussian_vp.description: Narrow Gaussian shells under VP and BP evolution in static and prescribed expanding backgrounds.
gaussian_vp.density_source: Positive mass with the homogeneous background prescribed through expansion.
gaussian_vp.virial_scope: Eleven exact full-particle native samples. The halo force is the actual applied constant-line PIC force.
gaussian_vp.boundary_scope: Saved endpoint occupancy and energy. Cumulative GPU wall-impact counts are unavailable.
gaussian_vp.marker_count_scope: Initial equal-mass realization. BP mergers change the number of objects while conserving mass.
